Job description

Position: DevOps Engineer / Sr. DevOps Engineer

Job Location: Gurgaon




Professional Experience

3-6 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, or related roles.
Proven experience in designing, deploying, and managing cloud environments on AWS and Azure.
Strong understanding of cloud architecture, infrastructure management, and deployment practices.



Key Responsibilities



Cloud Infrastructure Management
Design, deploy, and manage scalable, secure, and highly available cloud environments on AWS and Azure.
Leverage cloud-native services such as AWS ECS/EKS and Azure AKS to deploy and manage containerized applications.
Optimize cloud infrastructure for performance, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.


CI/CD Pipeline Development
Build, configure, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, and other automation tools.
Collaborate with development teams to integrate code quality, testing, and security checks into the deployment lifecycle.
Automate application build, testing, deployment, and release processes.


Containerization & Orchestration
Deploy, configure, and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
Implement best practices for container orchestration, scalability, availability, and resource utilization.
Troubleshoot container and Kubernetes-related issues across development and production environments.


Monitoring & Troubleshooting
Implement and maintain comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions to ensure system reliability and performance.
Monitor infrastructure, applications, and deployments to identify and resolve potential issues proactively.
Troubleshoot infrastructure and deployment issues and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely resolution.
Perform root-cause analysis and implement preventive measures for recurring issues.


Security & Compliance
Integrate security best practices into CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and application deployments.
Implement appropriate access controls, secrets management, and security configurations.
Ensure compliance with applicable industry standards, organizational policies, security requirements, and data-privacy regulations.
Work closely with security and engineering teams to identify and mitigate infrastructure and deployment risks.



Good-to-Have:

Experience with additional CI/CD tools like Jenkins.
Familiarity with configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible, Chef, Puppet).



Required Skills & Qualifications



Educational Background
B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field from a reputed institution.
